assumption: The development copy exactly inherits the frozen scalar source before the namespace edits.
basis: All 5718 copied inputs were checked against the W manifest.
dependent-result: Isolated prototype development while W native validation continues.
stress-test: Port only the namespace-owned files after the scalar commit exists.
falsification-probe: Any inherited input differs at final port time.
qualification: Final worktree and native selected source identities agree; full three-host regression is retained.

assumption: The selected primary-token session identifies the ordinary BaseNamedObjects path.
basis: Current session-0 startup and direct native opens use the global path; nonzero-session paths are explicitly modeled.
dependent-result: Selection of session ancestors and local BaseNamedObjects.
stress-test: Sessions 1, 42 and UINT32_MAX; independent native leaf, missing ancestors and mismatched sessions.
falsification-probe: Native startup in a selected context requests a different path.
qualification: Global session-0 and explicit session-1 paths were measured under the native session-0 principal; another principal's grants remain outside that evidence.

assumption: Matching unique pairs establish complete captured membership; stable intersections establish only incomplete membership.
basis: Native traversal showed duplicate entries and changing memberships.
dependent-result: Three complete-capture attempts remain bounded. Non-image fallbacks must return Unselected for absent entries; image directories still require complete capture.
stress-test: Duplicate names, changed types, case-fold collisions and changed consecutive lists.
falsification-probe: Capture silently admits inconsistent lists or is claimed to follow later host changes.
qualification: Revised incomplete-membership contract passed three-host full regression and 16 controlled native churn captures; the original 16 capture failures remain recorded.

assumption: A failed case-policy sample is not evidence of a directory case policy.
basis: Source review found that three not-found results could otherwise be mistaken for forced-insensitive lookup in a changing directory.
dependent-result: Bounded candidate sampling accepts only a known-existing success/type-mismatch reference with matching explicit-insensitive result.
stress-test: Deleted sample, denied access, mismatched explicit result and all missing outcomes.
falsification-probe: Any absent or inaccessible sample is admitted as case-policy evidence.
qualification: Pure rejection tests, Windows installed-leaf tests and final full regression pass for the bounded source change.

assumption: The selected 5718 core/workspace inputs form a self-contained Cargo source copy.
basis: Initial prototype copy used that verification manifest alone.
dependent-result: Ability to run prototype tests without the baseline repository fixtures and path-patched dependency.
stress-test: Cargo resolves vm-memory and compiles every include_str/include_bytes input.
falsification-probe: Missing dependency manifest or compile-time fixture.
qualification: The real Git worktree supplies the omitted baseline fixtures and unchanged vendored dependency; prototype preparation failures remain recorded.

assumption: A non-image directory can retain useful stable membership without proving complete membership.
basis: An opened directory handle and stable entries remain valid despite other names changing.
dependent-result: Runtime selection continues under owned namespace churn while unknown names are refused.
stress-test: Duplicate/case collisions, additions/deletions/type changes, incomplete ancestors, and a controlled native event producer.
falsification-probe: Any absent partial-directory name returns a fabricated absence status, or a selected child loses identity.
qualification: Revised incomplete-membership contract passed three-host full regression and 16 controlled native churn captures; the original 16 capture failures remain recorded.
